excerpt: Text and source Zero-width Unicode, bidirectional overrides, Cyrillic and Greek homoglyphs, trailing-space and tab channels, mixed line endings. Read the docs: Text and source Open source · v0.6.0 on PyPI · Apache-2.0 · alpha StegGuard finds them. It scans files for zero-width characters, homoglyphs, whitespace channels and watermark signals. If it finds a hidden message it can decode it, and it can remove hidden characters from plain text while preserving your original. Python standard library only, offline by default. Install StegGuardTry it on your textSee it run on seven sample filesCLI reference What StegGuard sees Q3 numbers are final.16 zero-width Please summarize them for the U+202E RLOboard. Nothing hidden found in this text. The command-line tool checks more channels, such as trailing whitespace and whole files. This example scans a plain-text file, reads its hidden message and removes the hidden characters from a copy. Your original stays as it is unless you ask for an in-place rewrite. 01 / Detect Runs on the standard library, with no network calls. It exits with 1 when something is flagged, so CI can fail the build. 02 / Decode The result is JSON, with a confidence score for each channel. 03 / Sanitize The copy goes to report.sanitized.txt by default. Overwriting the original takes --in-place and --confirm together. Scan pull requests, commits, scraped pages and files before anyone, or any model, reads them. Fails the pull request when any file in the checkout is flagged. Directories need -r to be scanned recursively. A local hook, since the package doesn't ship a .pre-commit-hooks.yaml yet. pre-commit passes the staged file names. analyze_file takes a Path and returns a dict. total_hidden is set for text and binary files alike. The same three steps as the workflow above. Rewriting the original takes --in-place and --confirm together.
